text:
alex_infra: Starting canary rollout of BMC firmware v1.9.3 to us-central1 GPU racks. Observed OOB session stalls on ~6/40 hosts, provisioning jobs stuck, PXE appears to hang.

deploy-bot: deploy: started rolling fw v1.9.3 to pool 'us-central-gpu' at 12:04 UTC :rocket:

maria_sre: On it. Are the affected hosts the same BMC model? Any common NIC or switch?
alex_infra: All affected are bmc model x1200-v2, connected via 10gbe-sfp to leaf-usc-3. Logs show repeated mctp disconnects and oob session timeouts. Sample from bmc logs:
```
[12:05:11] mctp: conn reset to 10.2.3.14: MCTP_ERR_TIMEOUT
[12:05:12] oob-session: wait for console -> timeout (120s)
[12:05:14] pxe: waiting for DHCPACK
```

kevin_fw: We reproduced something similar in lab last week when watchdog timeout was tightened in v1.9.3. Reverting that change fixed the mctp flaps. Might be the same.

tara_platform: Provision queue is backing up, ~120 jobs pending. Autoscaler can't allocate because nodes stay in provisioning. Can we pause the canary before hitting more racks? :exclamation:
alex_infra: Pausing canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary paused at 12:06 UTC. 6 hosts flagged for review.
maria_sre: I'll try soft BMC reboot on the 6 hosts and clear OOB sessions. If they come back, we can proceed with hotfix; if not, rollback to v1.9.2.

kevin_fw: Preparing micro-fix: revert watchdog tweak (delta -200ms). Uploading artifact: https://artifacts.internal/fw/v1.9.3-hotfix-01.bin
Command to target canary set:
```
rbctl oob apply-fw --ids bmc-abc,bmc-def,bmc-ghi --fw v1.9.3-hotfix-01
```

tara_platform: Cost FYI: idle GPUs due to backlog ~120 * 0.5hr est = ~2h of wasted capacity. Rough $450/hr estimate while backlog drains. Keeping finance in the loop.

alex_infra: Ran soft-reboot script on 4 hosts, they rejoined provisioning. 2 hosts still in 'oob-session-stalled' state. Script used:
```
for id in bmc-xyz bmc-123 bmc-abc; do sudo oobctl reboot --bmc $id; sleep 20; done
```

maria_sre: If the 2 remain stalled after hotfix, we'll cut the rollout and trigger full rollback. Also enabling verbose mctp tracing on the remaining hosts: `oobctl diag --mctp --level debug`.

kevin_fw: Hotfix applied to the 6 canary hosts, watching metrics. Initial telemetry: mctp reconnects dropped from ~30/min to <1/min within 120s.

deploy-bot: deploy: hotfix applied to 6 hosts; monitoring window started at 12:12 UTC. No new stalls reported for 9m so far. :eyes: 

maria_sre: Good progress. We'll keep the canary paused until we have a 1h clean window, otherwise rollback plan ready.

alex_infra: Thanks team — keeping this thread live. Will update if any of the two remaining hosts fail to recover in the next 10m.
